name: opsboard
description: Painel de ordens de serviço full-stack (React + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @opsboard/api" "npm run dev -w @opsboard/web"
scripts.contract:generate: npm run openapi:export -w @opsboard/api && npm run types:generate -w @opsboard/web
scripts.check:contract: npm run contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api-types.ts
